theme.title: Appearance
theme.intro: Colors, corner radius, name and logo for everyone – also on the sign-in page. Text colors are adjusted automatically so they stay readable (WCAG AA) in the light and dark color scheme.
theme.eyeDropper: Pick a color from the screen
theme.colorSchemeHint: For users who have not chosen one. Everyone can still switch between light and dark.
theme.appNameHint: Shown in the header, the window title and on the sign-in page, e.g. “ACME {{brand}}”. Empty = {{brand}}. The footer and the About page keep the product name.
theme.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most {{kb}} KB and 4096 × 4096 pixels. Wide logos are fine. SVG is not accepted because it can contain scripts. Prefer a transparent background so the logo works in the light and the dark color scheme.
theme.saved: Appearance saved – open pages update within a minute
theme.resetConfirm: Reset colors, color scheme, corner radius, display name and logo to the {{brand}} defaults?

contrast.title: Readability
contrast.textAdjusted: {{color}}: too light for text on a white page, so links and text use the darker {{used}} (contrast {{ratio}}:1).
contrast.darkTextOnFilled: {{color}} ({{scheme}}): buttons and badges use dark text, which is easier to read on this color (contrast {{ratio}}:1).
contrast.filledAdjusted: {{color}}: white text is hard to read on it, so buttons use the darker {{used}} (contrast {{ratio}}:1).
contrast.lowSurfaceContrast: {{color}} ({{scheme}}): buttons stand out little from the page (contrast {{ratio}}:1). Their text stays readable, but consider a stronger color.

errors.THEME_INVALID: Check the colors and the display name.
errors.THEME_LOGO_TOO_LARGE: The logo is too large (max. {{kb}} KB).
errors.THEME_LOGO_SVG: SVG logos are not accepted because they can contain scripts. Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
errors.THEME_LOGO_TYPE: The logo must be a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
errors.THEME_LOGO_DIMENSIONS: The logo can be at most 4096 × 4096 pixels.

sample.alert: Alerts and notices use the primary color.

about.title: About {{brand}}
about.mismatch: This page was loaded with version {{web}}, the server now runs {{server}}. Reload to use the current version.
about.browserSupport: Current versions of Microsoft Edge, Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox and Safari. Internet Explorer is not supported.

thirdParty.title: Third-party licenses
thirdParty.intro: {{brand}} is built on open-source packages. Package, version and license of every production dependency:
thirdParty.unavailable: The list is not part of this build.

status.title: System status
status.intro: Health of this {{brand}} server: readiness, components, integrations and runtime.
status.limited: Limited view for auditors: paths, host names and connection details are only shown to administrators.

monitoring.title: Health checks for monitoring
monitoring.intro: Point Gatus, Zabbix, Uptime Kuma, a load balancer or Kubernetes at these addresses to watch {{brand}} itself.
monitoring.healthHint: /api/health – public, always 200 while the process runs (liveness). Returns the version.
monitoring.readyHint: /api/ready – public, 200 when the vault is unlocked, the database answers and schedules are armed, otherwise 503 with the failing checks (readiness).
monitoring.metricsAuth: /api/metrics – Prometheus format, for administrators and auditors (session or API token).

runtime.pdfWorker: Drawn in a worker thread (60 s limit, one at a time)
runtime.pdfUnavailable: Drawn in the main thread – the worker thread could not start

retention.foreverHint: The database has {{size}} and keeps every run. Settings → Data retention can limit runs, e.g. to 400 days (the default of new installations); reports go with their run, the audit log is kept.

security.pendingNone: {{name}}=none takes effect after the first single sign-on of an administrator

updateNotice.migrations_other: Updated on {{when}}. {{count}} database migrations were applied:
